content: No official JSONL runner exists in CopilotKit (confirmed: only InMemory, Sqlite, Intelligence). Official docs bless subclassing InMemoryAgentRunner for custom persistence: override run() to persist threadId/input, override connect() to re-hydrate before super.connect(). AWS AgentCoreRunner is the canonical production example of this pattern. Key pitfall documented: connect() may arrive BEFORE any run() for a thread (first page load on an existing thread) — must handle explicitly or POST /agent/:id/connect 404s.
